answer: Declarations are reconciled in fable, so that the operator census is checkable by anyone, and relic publishes it each epoch. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 8 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a thread record. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
